steps.en: Download and unpack the release archive
steps.zh: 下载并解压 release 压缩包
抓取一个 JS 渲染的页面

steps.en: Loads the page in V8, runs scripts, keeps cookies and follows redirects
steps.zh: 在 V8 里加载页面、跑脚本、维护 cookie、跟随重定向

steps.en: Dumps the settled HTML/text/links — or a screenshot and PDF from its own render engine
steps.zh: 输出稳定后的 HTML/文本/链接——或用自己的渲染引擎出截图与 PDF

value.en: One self-contained binary (~70 MB) scrapes JS-heavy pages — add --stealth and it randomizes fingerprints and blocks trackers too
value.zh: 约 70 MB 的自足二进制就能抓 JS 重页面——加 --stealth 还能随机指纹、拦跟踪器

sources: README.md Install > Download (curl -LO https://github.com/h4ckf0r0day/obscura/releases/latest/download/obscura-x86_64-linux.tar.gz; tar xzf; archives include obscura and obscura-worker)

README.md Quick Start (obscura fetch https://example.com --eval "document.title"; obscura fetch https://news.ycombinator.com --dump html; --dump links/text/assets/original; --screenshot; --wait-until; --timeout)
README.md Rendering + Stealth Mode (screenshots, screencast, PDF; stealth build --features render,stealth, runtime --stealth flag: fingerprint randomization, 3,520 blocked domains)
README.md Start the CDP server (obscura serve --port 9222; --stealth) + Puppeteer/Playwright connect examples
